meta.store_context: Prices were read from homedepot.com search and product pages via an automated fetch with no store selected. HD showed its default store, NOT a Denver-area store. The lumber offered was Southern Yellow Pine (SYP), which points to a southern or eastern store. Denver-area stores mostly stock SPF/Hem-Fir/Doug-fir and incised PT, and lumber prices can differ noticeably by region and week.
meta.verified_meaning: verified:true means this exact price was displayed on homedepot.com on the date checked (for the default store). It does NOT mean it was checked at a Denver store. verified:false means the price is an estimate; see estimate_source.
meta.bulk_price: bulk_price.min_qty / price = HD's 'Buy N or more' price. Use it only when the line quantity meets min_qty.
meta.internet_number: null where the search page did not show it. URLs that point to /s/ are the HD search page the price was read from.
meta.source_url_note: For entries whose source_url is an /s/ search page, the query string is the search used (or an equivalent one) when the price was read. Re-run it to confirm. Direct /p/<internet#> URLs were built from the internet number and should redirect to the product page.
meta.do_not: Never show an estimated (verified:false) price as a Home Depot price. Label it 'estimate'.
